Run the PRUE deep model on a stack

Source: R/deep.R
fb_prue_predict.Rd

Applies the Fields of The World PRUE model to two dates of a stack, as the model was trained: red, green, blue and near-infrared reflectance of the earlier date, then of the later date, divided by 0.3, rows ordered from south to north, 256-pixel windows with a stride of 128 pixels whose softmax probabilities are averaged. On the 54 California test tiles of the validation, its probabilities differed from those of the Python implementation by at most 1.2e-4 (mean absolute difference 7e-8).

Usage

fb_prue_predict(
  stack,
  months = c(3, 7),
  model = fb_prue_download(),
  window = 256L,
  stride = 128L,
  device = "cpu"
)

Arguments

stack

An fb_stack with bands B04, B03, B02, B08.

months

Calendar months of the two input dates, the earlier first in the season (for example c(3, 7) in the northern hemisphere, c(9, 1) in the southern). For each month the clearest date of that month is used, or of an adjacent month.

model

TorchScript model file from fb_prue_download().

window, stride

Window size and stride in pixels.

device

"cpu" or "cuda".

Value

A SpatRaster with layers background, field and boundary.

Details

The model sees each pixel in the context of its window, so probabilities depend on the surrounding image: areas smaller than a window are padded by reflection, and the output for a small area can differ from the output for the same pixels within a larger area. Prefer areas of at least 256 x 256 pixels (about 1.3 km at 5 m).

Examples

# \donttest{
if (requireNamespace("torch", quietly = TRUE) && torch::torch_is_installed()) {
  s <- fb_example_stack("california")
  p <- fb_prue_predict(s, months = c(3, 7))     # downloads the model on first use
  fb_plot_maps(p)
}
# }
